title: Music Disk+ mod (mdpm)
description: A mod that adds a lot of sound effects noises & Music to Minecraft (enjoy, but just don't destroy your ears)
body:
Warning: some of this sfx or music can be loud, so please make your volume accectable for you
a mod witch adds sfx amd music to Minecraft
the sfx:

Yamete kudasai
